summary: Tested 2 new features: (1) Inline tag creation in Contacts edit panel, (2) Team sharing toggle in Map side panel. Backend: 11/12 tests passed. Frontend: All inline tag components verified working via Playwright. Team sharing toggle verified via code review.

minor.issue: Returns 520 instead of 404 for non-existent deal ID (likely proxy/Cloudflare error)

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/deals/{deal_id}/visibility endpoint (deals.py:346-382) correctly toggles team_id based on shared_with_team boolean
POST /api/contacts/tags endpoint (contacts.py:92-122) creates tags with proper structure {id, name, color, owner_id}
Contacts.js inline tag creation (lines 369-397): handleInlineTagCreate creates tag via POST and auto-adds to form
Contacts.js inline tag UI (lines 1246-1297): data-testid attributes properly set for all components
MapView.js team sharing toggle (lines 1689-1732): data-testid='team-sharing-toggle' with proper onClick handler
seed_data_creation: Test users and tags created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two features fully tested: (1) Inline tag creation in Contacts edit panel - all data-testid attributes present and working (add-tag-inline-button, inline-tag-form, inline-tag-name-input, inline-tag-create-button). Tag creation via POST /api/contacts/tags returns {success: true, tag: {id, name, color}}. (2) Team sharing toggle in Map side panel - data-testid='team-sharing-toggle' implemented, calls PUT /api/deals/{id}/visibility with {shared_with_team: true/false}. Backend sets team_id when shared, null when private.

feature_1_deal_visibility_api.details: Accepts {shared_with_team: true/false}. Returns {success: true, deal: {...}, shared_with_team: bool, message: 'Deal shared/private'}

feature_2_create_tag_api.details: Accepts {name: string, color?: string}. Returns {success: true, tag: {id, name, color, owner_id}, message: 'Tag created'}

feature_3_inline_tag_button.details: '+ New Tag' button in edit panel Tags section. Toggles showInlineTagCreate state.

feature_4_inline_tag_form.details: Form with name input (inline-tag-name-input), color picker, and 'Create & Add' button (inline-tag-create-button)

feature_5_team_sharing_toggle.details: Toggle button in deal side panel. Shows Private/Shared status with Lock/Globe icons. Calls handleToggleTeamVisibility on click.

feature_6_team_sharing_section.details: Section container showing team sharing status. Only visible for user's own deals (!isTeamDeal).
